term: named objective-truth calibration coverage and a remaining account
definition: NamedCoverage f is ActualStableDefinition f ∨ InvariantOnlyDefinition f ∨ ActualTruthOnlyDefinition f. RemainingDefinition f is the conjunction of their negations. Coverage concerns pointwise extensions under one supplied truth/profile family, not candidate-name equality. The broad comparison class allows any binary objective classifier; its philosophical admissibility is not established.
note: Analyst named coverage is an explicit open framework premise. Excluded middle proves only the four-way structural fork including RemainingDefinition; it does not prove named coverage. The actual-true-variable singleton control differs extensionally from all three named accounts. An additional admissibility restriction or proof of named exhaustion is a separate research obligation; failed search does not establish either.
